name: Vikunja
description: See your Vikunja Kanban boards and move or add tasks from the notch.
author: Giuseppe
details: Connect Vikunja Cloud or your own HTTPS server in Settings → Extensions → Vikunja. Choose a Kanban board from the notch, use a card's menu to move it on boards with manual columns, or add a task to the project without opening your browser.
features: Select a project Kanban board and browse its columns
Move tasks between manual columns and add tasks to the project
Open any task or the board in Vikunja
Test the connection and keep credentials in the macOS Keychain
Connect through Cloudflare Access with a service token
permissions: Network access only to the Vikunja instance you configure. Credentials are stored in the macOS Keychain.
